subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge for audit overlap, and targeted authn evidence
messages:
From: Amanda Fairchild <amanda.fairchild@veridianhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@veridianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge for audit overlap, and targeted authn evidence

Hi Rachel / Laura,

We're starting our Q4 vendor audit and Redwood is in scope. Two quick asks from our auditor that we'd like to get ahead of:

1) SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-12-31 (we need a signed PDF).
2) A bridge letter that confirms there were no material changes to controls during the period and covers an overlap window for our auditor (audit window: 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31).
3) Targeted control evidence beyond the report: specifically
   - MFA rotation log slice for privileged accounts (sample covering 2025-11-01 to 2026-01-31)
   - Authn event excerpt showing successful SSO + device fingerprint fields for a set of 5 IDs (we will provide identifiers if needed)
   - Recent access review snapshot for admin/privileged roles (the last quarterly review)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the report + bridge letter and the log slices? If you can, please share expected timelines and any delivery method you prefer (DocuSign for the bridge, secure Drive link for logs).

Our auditor prefers delivery by EOD 2026-09-18 to keep the schedule. Let me know if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Amanda
Senior Information Security Manager
Veridian Health
amanda.fairchild@veridianhealth.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Fairchild <amanda.fairchild@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge for audit overlap, and targeted authn evidence

Hi Amanda — thanks for the clear ask. We're able to help and will coordinate artifacts. Quick confirmations and a proposed delivery plan below.

Confirmations:
- SOC 2 Type II report (report period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): we have a signed PDF and can share a redacted copy as needed. Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (we'll upload to a secure Drive link).
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that covers controls stability through 2026-03-31. We'll send the draft for signature (DocuSign preferred).
- Targeted evidence: we can produce the requested slices: MFA rotation slice, authn event excerpt, and the access review snapshot. The MFA and authn slices are sensitive logs — we'll deliver as redacted CSV extracts over a secured Drive folder and provide hash fingerprints of the files.

Proposed timeline (to meet your auditor date of EOD 2026-09-18):
- Today (9/15): Confirm scope in writing (this email) and start slice collection.
- 9/16 morning: Deliver SOC 2 PDF and bridge-letter draft for review.
- 9/17 EOD: Deliver log slices and access review snapshot in secure Drive (with file hashes).
- 9/18: Finalize bridge letter via DocuSign if the draft is approved.

Could you confirm the list of 5 user IDs for the authn excerpt (or confirm we can choose a representative sample)? Also, please confirm whether we should redact IP/device fingerprints or include full fields — auditors usually request device fingerprint fields but we respect privacy constraints.

I'll loop in Vivek (ops) and Laura (compliance ops) to coordinate extraction and delivery.

Best,
Rachel
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Veridian audit — who owns which artifact?

Hey team — forwarding Amanda's ask above. High level: SOC2 PDF and bridge letter (external-facing), plus three targeted artifacts (MFA rotation slice, authn event excerpt for 5 IDs, access review snapshot). Timeline is tight (auditor wants by 9/18 EOD).

Suggested split:
- Laura: prepare SOC2 PDF and draft bridge letter (I'll need a short paragraph on control stability language). Can you get the draft by EOD 9/16?
- Vivek: work with infra to pull the MFA rotation logs and authn slices. We need the MFA rotation slice covering 2025-11-01 to 2026-01-31 and authn events for either the 5 IDs they provide or our representative sample if they don't. Deliverables should be CSV extracts with column headers and a short extraction README. Target 9/17 EOD.

Notes on scope and redaction: keep user identifiers pseudonymized if necessary — include stable hashed IDs for auditor mapping. Do NOT include raw passwords or secrets. For device fingerprint fields, include the fingerprint ID and device type; redact full user agent strings unless Laura thinks auditor needs them.

If infra needs an official pull request/trace ID for change control, Vivek let me know — I'll create the ticket.

Thanks — Rachel
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Fairchild <amanda.fairchild@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverables: SOC2 PDF, bridge letter draft, and targeted authn artifacts (Veridian)

Hi Amanda — following up with the deliverables per your auditor timeline. Please find the plan and links below.

Deliverables provided today (links & attachments):
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (signed report) — attached to this message and uploaded to a restricted Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Veridian/SOC2/2025/report
- bridge-letter-draft.docx — draft bridge letter uploaded for your review. We can execute via DocuSign once Veridian confirms wording.
- mfa-rotation-log-slice.csv — MFA rotation slice (2025-11-01 -> 2026-01-31). File includes pseudonymized user IDs, rotation_timestamp, rotated_by, and key_type.
- authn-event-excerpt.csv — authn events for the representative sample (we used the 5 IDs Veridian provided). Columns: hashed_id, timestamp, sso_provider, success, device_type, device_fingerprint_id.
- access-review-snapshot.pdf — export of last quarterly admin recertification with reviewer notes redacted where PII appears.

Delivery notes: all artifacts are in the secure folder with SHA256 file hashes in the extraction_readme.txt. We redacted PII where appropriate but kept stable hashed identifiers so auditors can reconcile events. If your auditor needs additional fields (e.g., full user agent strings), let us know and we'll evaluate sensitivity and feasibility.

Next steps for the bridge letter: please review the draft and send any language edits by EOD 9/19. Once approved, we'll route for DocuSign and deliver the executed letter.

If you have any trouble accessing the Drive link, tell me and we'll provide an alternative (SFTP or encrypted email).

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (application/pdf)
- bridge-letter-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
- mfa-rotation-log-slice.csv (text/csv)
- authn-event-excerpt.csv (text/csv)
- access-review-snapshot.pdf (application/pdf)
